fusions.name: Cracked on the Anvil
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and slams it into your shell, which deals 30 damage that ignores armour, leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Swung by the Rim
fusions.desc: Swings a plate of your shell through a cone 3 tiles ahead, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute Resolve
fusions.desc: Your blunt damage rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Knapped Scute
fusions.desc: Shapes a scute from your shell into a weapon. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
